title: Thoughts I Cannot Say Out Loud

current_concerns.primary_problems: Since the birth of her daughter approximately ten weeks ago, the patient has experienced unwanted, intrusive images and thoughts about possible harm coming to her baby. These thoughts are frightening and distressing to her. She avoids being alone with her daughter, especially during bathing, and repeatedly checks on her throughout the night.
current_concerns.goals: To stop the intrusive thoughts and feel safe caring for her daughter alone.
